mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale_quantity), 0) FROM (SELECT i.outbound_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS sale_quantity FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item i JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound o ON o.id = i.outbound_id AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.sales_order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND i.bundle_component_id IS NULL GROUP BY i.outbound_id UNION ALL SELECT i.outbound_id, MAX(i.bundle_sale_quantity) AS sale_quantity FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item i JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound o ON o.id = i.outbound_id AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.sales_order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND i.bundle_component_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.outbound_id) shipped

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_delivery_route_order a JOIN xsy_delivery_route d ON d.id = a.route_id AND d.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId} AND a.deleted = FALSE AND a.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.fulfillment_status IN ('SIGNED', 'EXCEPTION')
SELECT * FROM xsy_order_received_quantity_correction WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.*, i.product_name_snapshot AS productName, i.spec_name_snapshot AS skuName FROM xsy_order_received_quantity_correction c LEFT JOIN xsy_sales_order_item i ON i.id = c.order_item_id AND i.deleted = FALSE WHERE c.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_order_received_quantity_correction (order_id, order_item_id, sale_unit_snapshot, shipped_quantity, previous_received_quantity, received_quantity, reason, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{correction.orderId}, #{correction.orderItemId}, #{correction.saleUnitSnapshot}, #{correction.shippedQuantity}, #{correction.previousReceivedQuantity}, #{correction.receivedQuantity}, #{correction.reason}, #{correction.createdBy}, #{correction.createdAt})
